Orlando-based real estate investment firm Foundry Investment Management, the investment management arm of Foundry Commercial, has announced the final close of its third growth-market opportunistic private real estate fund, Foundry Owners’ Fund III, which was held on Oct. 28, 2026.

Fund III closed with $120 million in total equity capital commitments. Fund III is the largest fund in the Foundry Owners’ Fund series to date and nearly five times the size of Foundry’s prior fund, Foundry Owners’ Fund II, which closed in 2023 with $24.7 million in total equity capital commitments.

Fund III received commitments from approximately 75 investors, including endowments, pension plans, faith-based organizations, family offices, registered investment advisers and accredited individuals.
